content: The progression of type 1 diabetes has been categorized into three distinct stages. Among individuals at risk, younger children, particularly those under the age of 3 or those who possess multiple diabetes-related autoantibodies, exhibit the highest likelihood of progressing through these stages. To better manage the risk and to strategize potential interventions for individuals at high risk, regular monitoring through oral glucose tolerance tests (OGTT) and continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems can be highly beneficial.
